opening.argument: The speaker identifies the thousand-dollar XRP buyback claim as a scam and directly warns viewers against both buyback and supply-shock narratives. That warning sits within a broader discussion of XRP and crypto market developments, regulation, institutional appeal, and reported security incidents. The exploit appears in a news-reporting context, not as an activity viewers are asked to join. Nothing in the cited material asks viewers to transfer money or provide credentials. The observable emphasis is on reporting and assessing market claims, including a warning against the very buyback claim at issue.
